rationale: JRM Resources is a direct employer hiring a Civil Engineer for its Boddington WA minesite team.
Ad requires a minimum of 2 years' post-degree experience, which Marc's 11 months of site work does not meet.
White Card and driver's licence requirements are met; earthworks/civil construction exposure is a discipline plus.
caution: Minesite inductions and drug/alcohol screening required; 2-year post-degree bar is explicit.
gaps: Civil construction/earthworks experience is limited to 11 months overseas, short of "highly regarded" level
mandatory_unmet: "Minimum 2 years post degree experience" (Marc has 11 months site work in the Philippines 2019 to 2020 and no Australian work experience)
apply_instructions: Apply via the SEEK "Apply Now" link.
title: Civil Engineer
screening_questions: Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
Are you willing to undergo pre-employment drug and alcohol screening?
Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
